name: Reset App State 清空购物车
description:
SD-PRODUCT-013：Reset App State 功能验证
        Arrange: 登录并加购 3 件商品
        Act:     打开侧边栏菜单 → 点击 Reset App State
        Assert:  1. 购物车角标清零  2. 仍在商品列表页
descriptionHtml:
SD-PRODUCT-013：Reset App State 功能验证
Arrange: 登录并加购 3 件商品
Act: 打开侧边栏菜单 → 点击 Reset App State
Assert: 1. 购物车角标清零 2. 仍在商品列表页
statusMessage:
AssertionError: Reset 后角标应清零（等待超时）
assert False
 +  where False = wait_cart_badge_count(0)
 +    where wait_cart_badge_count = <pages.products_page.ProductsPage object at 0x7f8ea49214f0>.wait_cart_badge_count
statusTrace:
testcases/test_products.py:221: in test_reset_app_state_clears_cart
    assert products_page.wait_cart_badge_count(0), "Reset 后角标应清零（等待超时）"
E   AssertionError: Reset 后角标应清零（等待超时）
E   assert False
E    +  where False = wait_cart_badge_count(0)
E    +    where wait_cart_badge_count = <pages.products_page.ProductsPage object at 0x7f8ea49214f0>.wait_cart_badge_count
